text: {"assertions":["A bug in platform/config/loader.py was fixed on 2026-03-19 where the wrong environment was being used in the config loader.","The bug was caused by a bare except statement that swallowed an error, preventing proper failure handling.","The bug could be reproduced by booting the service with an unset profile variable.","The bug's symptom was a production endpoint appearing in a staging process, occurring on the first request after a cold start.","The fix involved narrowing the exception handler to let the failure propagate, implemented in PR #2467 on branch fix/wrong-environment-1.","After the fix, the flaky test in tests/platform/test_config_loader.py improved from 6 failures per 100 runs to zero failures.","The platform codebase is written in Python."]}
